knownStaleness.topic: A nation's own account, and the reason it is cited rather than the Crown's
knownStaleness.problem: This page is the Mississaugas of the Credit's own history of the treaty their territory is defined by, which is what docs/content-review.md 3.2 asks for and what a Crown page cannot be. It is dated - posted 3 November 2020 - and the same site publishes later settlements (the Rouge Tract Settlement, 2025) that this page does not mention. Nothing cited from it here depends on the settlement record being current: the sentence used names which cities fall inside the treaty boundary.
knownStaleness.action: re-fetch before drawing any claim about settlements, compensation or claims still in progress; the boundary sentence does not move

grainNote: One web page, one heading, no pagination. The flag is on the page's settlement narrative, not on its boundary statement, because those two go stale at completely different rates and a flag covering both would fire on everything.
